answer: The kernel I would price into every new account is Professed textile weaver accreditation with weavers guild attestation: an accreditation the guild renews after assessed looms, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. The price is not in coins but in friction: each fake needs its own an accreditation the guild renews after assessed looms, and the vertex of that friction is a hundred small errands no script can automate away. The relic is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
